releases.displayName: Be sure to start a new game

items.text: This is the big "Second Death" update that's been in the works for months. Your current run will likely be soft-locked, but contrary to my last post, you shouldn't lose your unlocked items. I'd still recommend starting a new game upon downloading this update. I'll post all the new features in an announcement soon.

releases.displayName: GHOST at DAWN: REBUILD UPDATE INCOMING

items.text: I will be uploading the REBUILD update to Steam later today or tomorrow. It will erase your previous save data upon the initial boot up. Unfortunately, this was necessary because of the massive changes made to the game. If you want to finish your current run, do so before installing the new update.

I assure you another investigation through The Pines Hotel will be worth it. There are new items, sound effects, animations, scares, enemy placements, game mechanics, options, along with a whole new look for the game. This will be the ultimate version of the game. I hope you enjoy it.
Four BRAND NEW challenges have been updated to the game. Completing them will unlock a new costume for Yuhiko and nigh unlimited ammo for the guns.
